appDescription: Noraehaja searches and plays Korean karaoke videos while parked, evaluates short recordings, and finds nearby restrooms with parking information and confirmed navigation handoff.

function.name: SEARCH_SONG
function.description: Runs a new video search using the song title or artist in the current request, replaces the displayed song results, and returns numbered matches.

query.description: The song title, artist name, or both supplied in the current search request.

function.name: SELECT_SONG
function.description: Plays a song from the latest displayed song search results using the result number explicitly selected in the current user request, while parked.

index.description: One-based song result number explicitly selected in the current user request.

function.name: RESTROOM_SOS
function.description: Finds nearby restrooms, reads current restroom candidates, selects a numbered candidate, or requests navigation to a restroom or its linked parking lot after confirmation. Uses current app results; live opening and parking vacancy are unverified.

operation.description: FIND refreshes nearby restroom results. READ returns the current results. SELECT opens a candidate. NAVIGATE prepares a destination and requires confirmation before sending it.

index.description: One-based candidate number from the current restroom results. Required for selection unless a candidate is already selected.

target.description: Destination kind. PARKING uses the parking lot linked to the candidate, if available. RESTROOM uses the restroom itself.

confirmed.description: True only when the user confirms the specific pending navigation destination from the preceding confirmation question.

listId.description: Current result list identifier returned by RESTROOM_SOS, when available. A changed list requires another selection.
